# React Simple Chatbot

> Build conversational chatbots in React with a list of steps. Written in TypeScript, works with React 18 and 19.

## Documentation Sets

- [Abridged documentation](https://lucasbassetti.github.io/react-simple-chatbot/llms-small.txt): a compact version of the documentation for React Simple Chatbot, with non-essential content removed
- [Complete documentation](https://lucasbassetti.github.io/react-simple-chatbot/llms-full.txt): the full documentation for React Simple Chatbot

## Notes

- The complete documentation includes all content from the official documentation
- The content is automatically generated from the same source as the official documentation
